notes: Combat VFX cue rules (mw-e29.3), bound to the same sim events and facts as the combat audio sheet so a hit is seen where it is heard. A clean hit throws the generic dust puff; metal striking metal or stone throws sparks instead (the most specific rule wins its layer), and so does a blade glancing off a raised shield. Every impact is oriented to the hit normal (back along the blow) and emits more for harder hits. A parry flashes on the parrier, facing the attacker, instead of any impact (the deflected hit's DamageApplied reads contact "parried", which no impact rule matches). Impacts stay where they happened rather than following the struck body. The material matrix (splinters, bone dust, blood) comes with mw-e29.4.
